method: node elimination from the previous PI rule of this degree (GPU Levenberg-Marquardt with annealing acceptance and node kicks, float32 search, float64 polish), unsymmetric, the 16 nodes on the boundary were then moved strictly inside along the solution manifold (projected gradient of a barrier penalty in the kernel of the Jacobian, Newton correction); checked numerically
author: Claude (Anthropic), commissioned and directed by Joerg Kubitz
